jobs.title: Account Executive
jobs.content: <p>What we look for: You have previously worked in an early-stage company and you know how to navigate a fast-growing organisation</p><p>5+ years of sales experience in SaaS/PaaS, or Big Data companies</p><p>Prior customer relationships with CIOs and important decision-makers</p><p>3+ years of experience exceeding sales quotas</p><p>Bachelor&#x27;s Degree</p>

jobs.title: AI Engineer - FDE (Forward Deployed Engineer)
jobs.content: <p>What we look for: Experience building GenAI applications, including RAG, multi-agent systems, Text2SQL, fine-tuning, with tools such as HuggingFace, LangChain, and DSPy</p><p>Expertise in deploying production-grade GenAI applications, including evaluation and optimizations</p><p>Extensive hands-on industry data science experience, leveraging common machine learning and data science tools such as Python and Apache Spark</p>
